subject.title: Fix silent provider-error retry after prior side effects

question: Should maintainers accept this PR's optional currentAttemptReplayMetadata attempt-result field and server_error retry-before-failover behavior as the canonical fix after rebase and proof, or choose a different open candidate?
rationale: The code change is compatibility- and session-state-sensitive, and there are multiple open candidate PRs for the same issue; automation cannot choose the permanent harness contract or canonical branch safely.

options.title: Accept this shape after proof and rebase
options.body: Require a conflict-free branch plus redacted full-runner or gateway proof, then treat the current-attempt metadata split as the canonical fix.

options.title: Choose another open candidate
options.body: If https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97966 or another branch has better proof or lower compatibility risk, make that PR canonical and close the rest after it lands.

options.title: Reject the new result field
options.body: Pause this PR if maintainers do not want the optional attempt-result field and ask for a different current-attempt side-effect signal.

recommendation.title: Accept this shape after proof and rebase
recommendation.body: Require a conflict-free branch plus redacted full-runner or gateway proof, then treat the current-attempt metadata split as the canonical fix.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has recent history on the adjacent incomplete-turn and message-delivery surfaces touched by this retry behavior.
